description:
Personal finance that stays on this device. See what is left to spend this month, log cash and card spends, set category budgets, track recurring bills, savings goals, people you owe, and a travel trip in local currency.

No bank login. No SMS scrape. Export CSV or a JSON backup anytime.

Travel Mode tracks a trip budget separately from home spend. One live trip is free.

Hindi and English.
promotionalText: What you still have left to spend, on this phone.
whatsNew: Liora: leftover to spend, people ledger, travel, Hindi + English.
reviewNotes: All data is localStorage on device. Create an expense with + then Manual. Travel is on Home (Travel card) or Plan. Unlock Pro is a local flag until IAP ships; it is not required to review the free demo trip.
